1: AI Security Bootcamp is running another (very timely) cohort, and has asked me to signal-boost them again. Apply at https://aisb.dev/sf26/ [ https://substack.com/redirect/8d0fb53b-d14c-4133-98ab-45c778e0400e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] .
